free_tier.stated: Dedicated-vCPU KVM instances: 2 vCPU with 4 GB RAM and 50 GB NVMe at KRW 24,000 a month excluding VAT, 4 vCPU with 8 GB at 44,000, 4 vCPU with 16 GB at 56,000, 4 vCPU with 32 GB at 80,000, and a 2 vCPU with 8 GB at 29,600. Each carries 300 GB of monthly outbound traffic on a 1 Gbps port, with overage priced in tiers from KRW 49 down to KRW 29 per GB.

egress.terms: 300 GB of monthly outbound is the whole allowance regardless of shape, so a 4 vCPU box buys no more traffic than the smallest; at KRW 49 per GB for the first excess terabyte, the traffic bill passes the server bill at about 500 GB over the allowance.
